curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can an eager intern manage the spiraling antics of an out-of-control idol long enough to pull off a career-saving comeback show?
curatedMovie.description: To save a struggling record label, intern Aaron Green takes on the daunting assignment of escorting his idol, unhinged rock star Aldous Snow, to Los Angeles for an essential comeback performance.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Irreverent, funny, and briskly paced, offering an easy-watching music adventure perfect for a fun night with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Nicholas Stoller, this music-fueled comedy blends showbiz satire with high-stress antics as an eager intern attempts to wrangle an out-of-control rock star.
